title: Understanding Training and Validation Errors
text: When the training error increases but the validation error decreases, it suggests a change in the model's complexity. Think about how this might affect the model's ability to generalize to new data.

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: Consider the bias-variance tradeoff. A decrease in validation error might indicate a change in the model's variance or bias. Which one do you think is more likely to have changed?

hintAnswer: The model's bias is likely lower.
title: Analyzing Bias
text: If the validation error decreases, what does this imply about the model's bias?
choices: The model's bias is likely lower.
The model's bias is likely higher.

hintAnswer: The model's variance is likely higher.
title: Analyzing Variance
text: If the training error increases, what does this imply about the model's variance?
choices: The model's variance is likely lower.
The model's variance is likely higher.
